A '''T-series tactical droid''' served under the [[Chevin/Legends|Chevin]] [[Major/Legends|Major]] [[Hoom Garaf]] of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] at the [[Third Battle of Aefao]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. Like all [[T-series tactical droid/Legends|T-series tactical droids]] built by [[Baktoid Combat Automata/Legends|Baktoid Combat Automata]], Garaf's [[Tactical droid/Legends|tactical droid]] struggled with interactions and disagreements with organic beings. Because of this, the [[Droid/Legends|droid]] [[Death/Legends|executed]] Garaf during the battle at<ref name="Warfare" /> the [[Planet/Legends|world]]<ref name="Rebel Dawn">''[[Rebel Dawn]]''</ref> [[Aefao]] due to a disagreement between them. This caused a chaotic [[Lightfight|firefight]] in the Separatist rear guard, which ultimately allowed the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] to win the battle.<ref name="Warfare" />

==Behind the scenes==
Hoom Garaf's tactical droid was mentioned in ''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]'', a [[2012]] reference book penned by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Paul R. Urquhart]].<ref name="Warfare" />
